title: Idol Solo 068 · 아워글래스 USSBBW(중국 아이돌) · 단청 · 걸터앉기

Background & Lighting: A bright pale warm-sand stylized background, a single strong warm light from one side, deep soft shadows in every crease and beneath every hanging roll, the vivid dancheong colours blazing, glossy anime highlights on every curve.
